newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens bourse tumbles 7.45pct in selloff.
newsitem.headline: Athens bourse tumbles 7.45pct in selloff.

text.p: Greek shares ended with sharp losses of 7.45 percent on Monday with the general share index settling at 1,206.54, down 97.09 points after Monday's panic selloff.
"The crisis in Albania was just another excuse. It all started with the capital market commission's warning on Wednesday which undermined sentiment," said a fund manager.

He said there was a lack of buyers on Monday, evidenced by the disappearance of bids even for blue chip shares, despite a late session intervention effort by National Bank, the market's locomotive during the recent rally.
"The market had gotten overpriced and we had a violent correction. I think we'll stabilise around the 1,120-1,150 area on the benchmark index," said another broker.
Banks lost 7.72 percent, construction shares fell 7.98 percent along with industrials, down 7.54 percent.
Losers led gainers 222 to 19 with five issues unchanged. Trading volume was 16.7 billion drachmas.
